items.title: 10.5 Oxidation number ke tareeqe se redox muadle balance karna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.5 with Sample Problem 10.4 and Quick Check 10.3, printed pages 217-219.

blocks.text: Oxidation number method se redox equations balance karne ke liye yeh steps (qadam) kiye jate hain:

items: Redox reaction ki skeleton equation (khaka, bina balance ki equation) likhein.
Woh elements pehchanein jin ka oxidation number reaction ke doran badalta hai.
Jin elements ka oxidation number badla hai, un ke symbols ke oopar oxidation number likhein.
Equation ke dono taraf atoms ko arrows (teeron) se jor kar oxidation number ki tabdeeli dikhayein. Yeh batata hai ke kitne electrons liye ya diye gaye.
Oxidation number ke izafe (increase) aur kami (decrease), yani diye aur liye gaye electrons, ko munasib number se zarb (multiply) de kar barabar karein.
Baqi equation inspection (hit and trial, dekh kar andaza) se balance karein.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain!
blocks.text:
Inspection se balance karne ki tarteeb: pehle nitrogen, oxygen aur hydrogen ke siwa sab elements ke atoms balance karein. Phir nitrogen (agar ho).
Phir oxygen (agar ho).
Aakhir mein hydrogen (agar ho).

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein!
blocks.text:
a) Agar kisi species ke element ka oxidation number sirf barhe ya sirf ghate, to woh species equation mein ek hi baar likhi jati hai.
Zn(s) + HCl(aq) → ZnCl₂(aq) + H₂(g)
b) Agar element ka oxidation number ek saath barhe bhi aur ghate bhi (self-redox ya disproportionation), to woh species do baar likhi jati hai: pehli oxidation number ke izafe ke liye, doosri kami ke liye.
Cl₂ + NaOH + Cl₂ → NaCl + H₂O + NaOCl
c) Agar element ke kuch atoms ka oxidation number badle aur kuch ka na badle, to bhi species do baar likhi jati hai: pehli tabdeeli ke liye, doosri be-tabdeel hisse ke liye.
HNO₃ + Cu + HNO₃ → Cu(NO₃)₂ + H₂O + NO₂
HCl + K₂Cr₂O₇ + HCl → Cl₂ + KCl + CrCl₃ + H₂O
(Note: kitab (b) mein likhti hai ke species “RHS” par do baar likhi jati hai, lekin us ki apni misalon mein Cl₂ aur HNO₃ baen taraf (LHS) do baar likhe gaye hain.)

blocks.title: Sample Problem 10.4
blocks.problem:
Is equation ko oxidation number method se balance karein:
K₂Cr₂O₇ + HCl → KCl + CrCl₃ + Cl₂ + H₂O
steps: 1- Skeleton equation likhein: K₂Cr₂O₇ + HCl → Cl₂ + KCl + CrCl₃ + H₂O
2- Har element ka oxidation number likhein: K +1, Cr +6, O −2, H +1, Cl −1 (baen taraf); Cl₂ mein Cl 0, KCl mein Cl −1, CrCl₃ mein Cr +3, H₂O mein H +1 aur O −2.

3- Badalne wale elements: Cr +6 se +3 (har Cr 3 electrons leta hai, do Cr = 6e⁻) — Cr reduce hua, K₂Cr₂O₇ oxidizing agent hai. Cl −1 se 0 (Cl₂ banne mein 2 Cl atoms = 2e⁻ dete hain) — Cl oxidize hua, HCl reducing agent hai.
4- Half reactions: K₂Cr₂O₇ → 2CrCl₃ (reduction, 6e⁻ liye) aur 2HCl → Cl₂ (oxidation, 2e⁻ diye).
Electrons barabar karne ke liye oxidation wali half reaction ko 3 se zarb dein: 3 × 2HCl → 3Cl₂, yani 6HCl → 3Cl₂ (6e⁻ diye = 6e⁻ liye).
5- Inspection: K ke liye 2KCl chahiye. Daen taraf Cl ab 6 (3Cl₂) + 2 (2KCl) + 6 (2CrCl₃) = 14 hain, is liye baen taraf 14HCl chahiye, yani 8HCl aur jorein.
H aur O: baen taraf 14 H aur 7 O hain, is liye daen taraf 7H₂O (pehle se 1 H₂O tha, 6H₂O aur jore).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Is method ka asal usool: jitne electrons reducing agent deta hai, utne hi electrons oxidizing agent leta hai. Pehle electrons barabar karein (yahan 6 = 3 × 2), phir baqi atoms ko inspection se barabar karein, aur aakhir mein har element ke atoms dono taraf gin kar check karein.

blocks.prompt: i. Fe₂O₃(s) + CO(g) → Fe(s) + CO₂(g) balance karein.
blocks.explanation: Fe +3 se 0 (do Fe = 6e⁻ liye); C +2 se +4 (har CO 2e⁻ deta hai), to 3CO chahiye: Fe₂O₃ + 3CO → 2Fe + 3CO₂.

blocks.prompt: ii. MnO₂ + HCl → MnCl₂ + H₂O + Cl₂ balance karein.
blocks.explanation: Mn +4 se +2 (2e⁻ liye); 2Cl⁻ → Cl₂ (2e⁻ diye), to ek Cl₂. MnCl₂ ke liye 2 aur Cl chahiye, kul 4HCl; O ke liye 2H₂O: MnO₂ + 4HCl → MnCl₂ + 2H₂O + Cl₂.

blocks.prompt: iii. Fe²⁺(aq) + MnO₄⁻(aq) → Fe³⁺(aq) + Mn²⁺(aq) balance karein.
blocks.explanation: Mn +7 se +2 (5e⁻ liye); Fe +2 se +3 (1e⁻ diya), to 5Fe²⁺. Acidic solution mein O aur charge ke liye 8H⁺ aur 4H₂O: 5Fe²⁺ + MnO₄⁻ + 8H⁺ → 5Fe³⁺ + Mn²⁺ + 4H₂O.

blocks.prompt: iv. K₂Cr₂O₇ + FeSO₄ + H₂SO₄ → Cr₂(SO₄)₃ + Fe₂(SO₄)₃ + K₂SO₄ + H₂O balance karein.
blocks.explanation: Do Cr +6 se +3 (6e⁻ liye); Fe +2 se +3 (1e⁻ diya), to 6FeSO₄ → 3Fe₂(SO₄)₃. Sulfate ginein: daen 3 + 9 + 1 = 13, baen 6 FeSO₄ ke baad 7H₂SO₄ chahiye; H ke liye 7H₂O: K₂Cr₂O₇ + 6FeSO₄ + 7H₂SO₄ → Cr₂(SO₄)₃ + 3Fe₂(SO₄)₃ + K₂SO₄ + 7H₂O.

items: Steps: skeleton, badalne wale elements, oxidation numbers likhna, tabdeeli arrows se, electrons barabar karna, baqi inspection se.
Inspection ki tarteeb: pehle baqi elements, phir N, phir O, aakhir mein H.
